name: kodel
description: Kodel: a local MCP engine that runs spec-driven pipelines inside your coding agent

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --outfile dist/kodel.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build src/hook-bin.ts --target node --outfile dist/kodel-hook.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/kodel.js dist/kodel-hook.js
